_note: The studio's paths and sizes, read by tools/paint.js (every script goes through it). Set for Drok by Leonard, AD on 2026-11-19. Paths are relative to the studio folder unless absolute; use forward slashes, even on Windows.
_judge: Robin's judging size: the game's design size in CSS pixels, portrait (the game's client/src/layout.ts and docs/platform.md).
_filePx: The files' scale: 2 means 2x files drawn at half size in CSS pixels. Written into every atlas as meta.filePx. A starting point (mine): the game's canvas is 412 by 915 today, so 2x files only show their detail once the game draws at the phone's own pixels; asked of Victor, GD on 2026-11-19.
_facing: For a thing with one facing that the game flips. Drok is seen from above with several facings; how many, and how they are named, is open with Victor, GD (docs/direction.md).
_canvas: Where @napi-rs/canvas is: the Survival game's copy, checked 2026-11-19. Drok's own game folder has none.
_blender: Empty: tools/blender.js finds the newest install under Program Files (Blender 5.2 on Robin's PC, checked 2026-11-19).
_player: Our hero for scale in every judging picture: the atlas json once it exists, and the height in CSS pixels of the code-drawn stand-in until then. 64 is a starting guess (mine) for a hero seen from above on a 412 wide screen; the first still shows two sizes and Robin picks.
_stage: The judging scene at the files' scale (824 by 1830), and where a thing's feet go in it, in file pixels: the middle of the play area, since the camera follows the hero. No stage picture exists until the first still.
_colours: The ink line's colour and the flat ground colour of the quick judging pictures. Stand-ins (mine) until Robin has picked the look: a dark ink and a dull dark ground, so nothing is judged on a bright meadow green.
